# Inertia index page

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

A CRUDDY index controller passes a typed ViewModel to resources/js/pages/<Area>/Index/Page.vue; its table is a TableQuery (search, declared filters and sorts from the URL, an unknown one a 400) with each row's actions decided on the server.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make crud --flavor=resource <Name>`.

Kit: @kit/ui Page, @kit/ui ButtonGroup, @kit/ui InertiaAction, @kit/ui DataTable, @kit/ui IndexToolbar, @kit/ui RowActions.
- `Page` from `@kit/ui` for the page shell: Wraps the whole page with title and breadcrumbs; its #actions slot holds the header actions (ui-page.header-actions). No SectionHeader repeating the title above the table (props: title, #actions).
- `InertiaAction` from `@kit/ui` for the add action: The create action by name in the header's ButtonGroup (null renders nothing) (props: action).
- `DataTable` from `@kit/ui` for the rows: The record list, server-driven: rows, URL state, empty states (props: table (TableData)).
- `IndexToolbar` from `@kit/ui` for the filters: Search and the server's filter choices (DataTable renders it) (props: table.choices).
- `RowActions` from `@kit/ui` for the row menu: Per-row actions from the server (DataTable renders it) (props: row.actions descriptors).
Checks: 20, 21, descriptors, js-imports, vm.typed-pages, vm.shaped-arrays, vm.nested-reach, vue.bare-handler-argument, inertia.pure, vm.page-size, ui.page-purpose, ui.page-view-model. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Conventions:
- Every rendered page extends PageViewModel; widgets and partials use ViewModel; `$standalone = true` opts a deliberate exception out (rule ui.page-view-model).

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Does the list need sorting, filters, row actions or reordering?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=ui-page.index` to see its siblings.
